images.title: Muse: kitchen · high confidence
images.observations: A kitchen with floral-patterned wallpaper, a decorative border, white cabinets, dark green countertops, and wood-look plank flooring. A peninsula with a dark green countertop and a perforated or lattice-style front panel separates the work area from the foreground space. A wall-mounted heating unit is mounted low on the left wall, and a window air-conditioning unit is visible high on the right wall.
images.planningUse: Decide whether to keep the kitchen cabinets, dark-green countertops, and peninsula.

images.title: Muse: kitchen · high confidence
images.observations: A close kitchen view showing white upper and lower cabinets with dark green countertops and backsplash. A freestanding range with a black cooktop and stainless-steel oven front is positioned beneath a white over-range microwave. A black dishwasher is installed beside the sink run, and a double-bowl sink with a gooseneck-style faucet sits below two windows.
images.planningUse: Decide whether to keep the kitchen cabinets, dark-green countertops, and peninsula.

images.title: Muse: bathroom · high confidence
images.observations: Bathroom with a toilet under a tall window, tiled floor, floral lower-wall covering, wall cabinet, and a tub/shower with frosted sliding doors on the right. No sink/vanity is visible in this view; finishes and wallpaper show wear.
images.planningUse: Decide whether bathroom refurbishment is in scope or only the new powder room.

images.title: Muse: bathroom · high confidence
images.observations: Bathroom view dominated by a tub/shower with frosted sliding doors in a gold-tone frame, with a toilet and tall window to the left. Floral wall covering and painted walls are visible around the window.
images.planningUse: Decide whether bathroom refurbishment is in scope or only the new powder room.

images.title: Muse: exterior · high confidence
images.observations: Exterior front view of a two-story attached or semi-attached house under a clear sky. Ground floor has a stone-veneer-appearing lower facade, multiple large front windows, and two separate stepped entrances visible at left and center-right. Upper floor has siding and brick-appearing areas, multiple double-hung-appearing windows, black shutters, and a dark vertical flue or chimney element.
images.planningUse: Photograph and measure all interior rooms on site, specifically locating any kitchen and any existing toilet/bathing room, since none are identifiable in this exterior view.

images.title: Muse: exterior · high confidence
images.observations: Exterior front view of a two-story house from a slightly angled street-side viewpoint, showing a lawn and sidewalk in the foreground. Ground floor shows stone-veneer-appearing cladding, two grouped window bays, a dark decorative door at left, and a light-colored door at center-right, each reached by steps. Upper floor shows siding, brick-appearing sections, grouped windows with black shutters, and a dark vertical flue or chimney element.
images.planningUse: Measure the interior plan on site and label each room by direct observation rather than inferring room use from the facade.

images.title: Muse: circulation · high confidence
images.observations: Upper-level hallway/landing with wood flooring, stair railing, tiled ceiling, and multiple door openings. Wall and trim finishes appear worn with visible scuffs and paint loss on the railing.
images.planningUse: Measure hallway widths, door openings and understair enclosure dimensions on the circulation routes.

images.title: Muse: basement · high confidence
images.observations: Basement view with carpeted stairs, red and cream patterned tile flooring in the foreground, a concrete-floored rear area, a small high window, exposed ductwork, and a radiator  The rear ceiling area is open or unfinished with visible framing, wiring, and fluorescent lighting.
images.planningUse: Nominate candidate powder-room zones for measurement: basement, an understair area visible at the left in listing-photo-06, or another unobstructed ground-floor bay, accepting none is yet confirmed feasible.

images.title: Muse: basement · high confidence
images.observations: Long basement room with red and cream patterned tile flooring, painted beams, a large insulated or wrapped duct along the ceiling, small high window, wall outlets, and a wooden  Walls show scuffs, patches, and a rectangular boarded or patched area; no bathroom or kitchen fixtures are visible.
images.planningUse: Nominate candidate powder-room zones for measurement: basement, an understair area visible at the left in listing-photo-06, or another unobstructed ground-floor bay, accepting none is yet confirmed feasible.

images.title: Muse: other · medium confidence
images.observations: Interior view of an enclosed porch or sunroom-like space in the foreground, with wood-appearing flooring, multiple windows, floral-border wallpaper, and a suspended tile ceiling. Open wood French doors with multiple glass panes lead to an adjacent empty interior room; similarity or adjacency beyond this visible opening should not be assumed for other photos. The adjacent room has wood-appearing flooring, a ceiling fan, small high windows, a wall-mounted air-conditioning-appearing unit, and baseboard heating-appearing elements.
images.planningUse: Measure this room and the room beyond on site and confirm their current uses and connecting door operation.

images.title: Muse: other · medium confidence
images.observations: Interior view of an enclosed porch or sunroom-like space with wood-appearing flooring, a suspended tile ceiling, floral wallpaper and border, and a bank of windows on the left wall. A black freestanding stove with a vertical and angled flue sits on a raised hearth-like base against the far wall. Wood French doors with multiple glass panes are visible at right, and a long low covered unit with decorative grilles runs below the left windows.
images.planningUse: Measure the room, window openings, stove and flue clearances as observed on site, and verify the status and permitted use of the stove and flue with qualified professionals before relying on them.

images.title: Muse: living · medium confidence
images.observations: An unfurnished room with wood-plank flooring, visible wear marks, and light-colored patches on the floor surface. A suspended tile ceiling with a ceiling fan and integrated lights is visible. Two high windows with blinds or louvers are visible on the left wall, with a window air-conditioning unit below the smaller window.
images.planningUse: Measure the room, window, and cased-opening positions before considering any change of use, including whether any part could support a powder room without assuming adjacency.
